description: This source file defines an abstract class 'MidiPortSelector' which provides a user interface component (using a Spinner) to select MIDI ports from available MIDI devices. It manages device callbacks, updates the list of MIDI ports dynamically, and handles port selection and resource cleanup.

classes.name: MidiPortSelector
classes.description: An abstract class that manages MIDI port selection via a Spinner UI component, handling device addition, removal, and status updates.

methods.name: MidiPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing MIDI device callback, populating ports, and setting up UI.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Resets the selection to no port.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new MIDI device by adding its ports to the selectable list.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Removes ports of a device that has been disconnected.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates port availability based on device port status changes.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for handling port selection.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for cleaning up resources.
